about: Part wfire's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row wfire, 'Inputs and outputs'; docs/game-parts/wfire.md). The weapon actions (A_FirePistol, A_FireShotgun, A_FireCGun, A_FireMissile, A_Punch, A_Saw) are ACTTAB's, entered by upstream's JML through callAction, which ref816's --capture does not count: they are checked inside captured and synthetic calls of part pspr's P_MovePsprites (its own args.json entry), which reaches them through tickPsprite, setPsprite and ACTTAB, as part pspr checked its actions (tools/native/gparts/wfire.py). The entries below say each routine's inputs and outputs; forms beyond gameroutine.py's, read by wfire.py: the destination sb:NAME (a place of game/wfire/wfire.inc's scratch block, SB_WFIRE + its offset), the destination lz:NAME (a zero-page name of milestone 9's lgame.inc: GS_PSP) and "as": "psp" (upstream's psprite, its near address, becomes its number: 0 the weapon, 1 the flash). bulletSlope leaves bulletslope in upstream's WP_SLOPE (scratch), which gunShot reads: an output of one and an input of the other. P_SpawnPlayerMissile and the actions return nothing.
